# Rise Personal

> Rise Personal is a personal branding agency for founders, executives, doctors, consultants and experts in the Gulf and Europe. It positions clients where reputation is built: in the room first, then online. Based in Dubai, working remotely. Founded and led by Mohamed El Sawaf, with a team of specialists and a group of sister companies (DRP9 Tech, La7ma, WAI-S, DRP9, Wijhat Travel, Bnsights, Imolty.ai, Uniek AI).

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.risepersonal.com/): what Rise Personal does and how it works
- [How we work](https://www.risepersonal.com/how-we-work.html): the three stages, what you approve, how confidentiality and pricing work
- [The Brand DNA Report](https://www.risepersonal.com/brand-dna-report.html): free 4-minute quiz that gives you a six-page PDF report: your brand archetype, three words and a 7-day plan. Runs in the browser, no sign-up
- [The 12 brand archetypes](https://www.risepersonal.com/archetypes.html): Sage, Creator, Ruler, Hero, Explorer, Magician, Lover, Jester, Everyman, Caregiver, Innocent, Outlaw, one page each
- [Personal branding for founders](https://www.risepersonal.com/for-founders.html), [for executives and boards](https://www.risepersonal.com/for-executives.html), [for doctors and experts](https://www.risepersonal.com/for-doctors-and-experts.html)
- [Personal branding in the UAE](https://www.risepersonal.com/personal-branding-uae.html), [Saudi Arabia](https://www.risepersonal.com/personal-branding-saudi-arabia.html), [Egypt](https://www.risepersonal.com/personal-branding-egypt.html), [Europe](https://www.risepersonal.com/personal-branding-europe.html)
- [Human-powered marketing](https://www.risepersonal.com/human-powered-marketing.html): marketing built on people, because people trust people
- [The Journal](https://www.risepersonal.com/journal.html): essays on personal branding, archetypes and the three words people remember you by
- [Privacy and discretion](https://www.risepersonal.com/privacy-and-discretion.html): how client work stays confidential and what the site collects

## Facts
- Positioning: on the ground first, online second.
- Client work is confidential and starts under an NDA. Clients are never named without written approval.
- Markets: UAE, Saudi Arabia, wider Gulf, Egypt, Europe. Language today: English (Arabic planned).
- No office in Saudi Arabia or Egypt. Based in Dubai, working remotely.
